title: Winter Palace Hotel
scope: Standing historic Winter Palace Hotel on Luxor’s Nile Corniche. Includes the three guest floors above the arcaded base, the main landing with paired stairs, and connected end and garden ranges of the old palace.
limitations: Reconstruction of the durable standing exterior based on public-domain street views. Heights, rear roof junctions, garden-side fenestration and stair profiles are estimates.

The model represents the historic hotel block and entrance before the 2026–27 conservation works. The separate Pavillon, garden complex, temporary works, interiors and any unconfirmed changes to the hotel are outside scope.
Warm stucco, light railings and cool glazing are based on the 2007 color view. Landscaping and finials are simplified.
